*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager** to lead platform strategy, drive stakeholder alignment, and ensure seamless collaboration between business and technical teams throughout the product life cycle.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the platform by organizing requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation with business and development stakeholders
* Create and deliver thorough training sessions to equip business users and stakeholders with platform usage skills and best practices
* Enable cross-departmental communication to define project goals and ensure a common understanding of platform features
* Assist in the design and development process by matching product features to changing business needs and regulatory demands
* Direct user acceptance testing efforts to confirm solutions fulfill specified requirements and quality benchmarks
* Partner with support and operations teams to maintain smooth platform upkeep and consistent performance
* Track and handle stakeholder expectations across the project lifecycle, maintaining transparency and prompt issue resolution
* Help enhance training materials and enablement approaches continuously, drawing on user feedback and platform changes
* Collaborate with a team of 3-5 colleagues and coordinate with third-party vendors when needed to achieve project goals

**Requirements**

* 12-18 years of overall IT experience, with a solid foundation in product management, product life cycle, product roadmap, and product vision
* Skills in connecting technical and business viewpoints to align platform capabilities with user needs
* Ability to manage stakeholders and balance varied expectations between business and technical groups
* Experience creating and delivering training programs suited to different user groups and proficiency levels
* Aptitude for converting complex business needs into clear, actionable technical specifications for development teams
* Proven track record of driving cross-functional collaboration and enabling effective communication across departments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About Turing**
================

Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

**About the Role**

Turing is looking for a high-caliber Product Manager to lead critical product areas across our talent, marketplace, vetting, and platform ecosystem. This person will step into a high-ownership role and should be able to combine strong product judgment, design taste, data-driven decision making, technical fluency, and structured business thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of user experience, systems thinking, analytics, and execution — someone who is equally comfortable shaping product direction, defining elegant user experiences, and driving cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment.

**Why this role matters**

Turing works with many of the world's leading AI labs and enterprises to help build, improve, and scale advanced AI systems. We sit at the intersection of frontier AI, high-quality talent, and complex product/platform workflows - which means the problems here are real, hard, and highly consequential.

This role sits at the core of how Turing builds scalable, high-quality experiences across talent and customer workflows. The right person will help raise the bar on product execution, clarity of thinking, and quality of experience across the organization.

**What you'll own**

You will lead product strategy and execution across some of Turing's most important platform surfaces, including areas such as:

* Talent discovery, search, and matching
* Talent onboarding and profile quality
* Vetting, trust, and integrity systems
* Marketplace workflows and hiring manager experience
* Internal platforms and operational tooling
* Cross-functional product initiatives spanning product, engineering, design, data, and operations

**What you'll do**

* Own roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a core product area
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured product plans, clear requirements, and strong execution
* Drive product development with a sharp eye for user experience, workflow design, and quality
* Use data deeply to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, prioritize investments, and measure impact
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, QA, and operations to ship high-quality products quickly
* Balance short-term execution with long-term product and platform thinking
* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems
* High ownership, urgency, and a strong bias for execution

**Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or a similarly rigorous discipline, ideally from a top-tier institution such as IIT or equivalent globally recognized universities
* MBA from a top-tier university is a plus, but not required
* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products
* Strong track record of partnering closely with engineering and design teams to ship polished, high-quality user experiences

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**
----------

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Bandhoo is a technology-driven company building SaaS solutions for construction project execution and workforce management.

BOSCO is a workforce management platform that supports attendance, productivity tracking, workforce compliance, contractor payroll, and workforce marketplace operations.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager – BOSCO to take ownership of BOSCO. You will work with engineering, design, and business teams to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver useful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the BOSCO product roadmap and priorities in collaboration with the CTO and leadership team.

· Manage the product lifecycle from user discovery and requirements gathering to prioritisation, development, release, and continuous improvement.

· Improve marketplace matching, fulfilment, user engagement, and messaging efficiency.

· Improve workflows for attendance, productivity tracking, workforce compliance, and contractor payroll.

· Speak with workers, contractors, field supervisors, HR teams, and customers to understand problems and improve product usability.

· Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria; coordinate with engineering and design teams during development.

· Support sprint planning, review product builds, prioritise bugs, and help deliver releases on time.

· Track product adoption, engagement, retention, matching, and fulfilment metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

· Collaborate with business and operations teams to align product improvements with customer and business needs.

**Requirements**

· 1–3 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, HRTech, workforce management, marketplaces, or operations-focused technology.

· Understanding of agile product development and the software development lifecycle.

· Experience with workforce management, contractor management, payroll, or marketplace products.

· Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, PostHog, or Amplitude.

· A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Clear communication and collaboration skills.

· A proactive approach, ownership mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

job_description:
### **Job Title**

Global Product Manager - Respiratory Accessories

### **Job Description**

As a **Global Product Manager(GPM)- Respiratory Accessories,** you will work on **sustaining and optimizing the existing respiratory accessories portfolio** , including roadmap prioritization, portfolio simplification, margin, and lifecycle performance

**Your role:**

  

**Product roadmap and go-to-market understanding**

* Owns the **execution of the claims roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams** to prioritize validated claims based on market trends and regulatory requirements, while continuously optimizing the strategy through analysis of competitor activity, customer insights, and compliance needs.
* **Maintains relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) to align their insights and advocacy** **with product strategy** , driving engagement through advisory boards and educational initiatives to enhance product credibility, market influence, and thought leadership while measuring impact on market adoption and positioning.
* Collaborates extensively with regional cross-functional teams to guide channel strategies and develop robust go-to-market plans that drive product adoption and revenue growth
* Evaluates market performance using advanced analytics and market insights to assess product success, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions to adjust strategies and enhance market competitiveness. Assists in developing testing protocols by providing support in designing, implementing, and refining procedures to ensure accurate and reliable evaluation of processes, products, or systems.
* **Manages the entire product development lifecycle process from concept through launch, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to quality standards, and alignment with project objectives.** Monitors and analyzes product performance metrics to evaluate success, identifies areas for improvement, and informs strategic decisions for enhancing product effectiveness and achieving business objectives.

**Global Product Management experience**

* Develops and maintains value propositions and creates business cases to effectively communicate the benefits and justify investments, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and supporting decision-making processes. GPM is **accountable for business case development & realization** . GPM is accountable for **commercial, IB, and technical simplicity** .
* GPM is accountable for developing claim (clinical, economic, technical etc) ambition, roadmaps and plans to drive and deliver on price points in partnership with key stakeholders
    
  **Develops comprehensive product, software, and lifecycle specifications aligned with strategic portfolio marketing strategies** , ensuring they meet customer needs and achieve long-term business objectives effectively. Operates with limited supervision and broad guidelines to implement product strategies in collaboration with regional Centers of Excellence, aiming to optimize product margins and ensuring alignment with overall business goals and financial targets.

**Experience in regulated industries**

* Ensures **compliance with regulatory requirements and quality standards throughout the product lifecycle** , collaborating with regulatory affairs and quality assurance teams to mitigate risks and maintain product integrity.
* Maintains a **deep understanding of industry dynamics** , technological advancements, and market shifts and analyzes market trends, competitive landscape, and consumer behavior to anticipate challenges and opportunities.
Identifies opportunities and implements continuous improvement and innovation initiatives in product offerings, informing strategic decisions for the product roadmap to enhance overall performance and align with market demands.  

  
  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You’ve acquired **8+ years of experience** in an international business environment in the field of product management, marketing, or related commercial/strategic role in medical devices or health technology
* You have a **Bachelor's/ master’s degree** in business administration, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management or equivalent.
* Medical-device product manager with **experience in accessories, consumables, sustaining products, and regulated portfolio management.** Exposure to **Regulatory frameworks** (FDA, EU MDR) and Reimbursement considerations
* Expertise experience **delivering complex projects** to meet demanding features, cost, quality and launch targets. Your skills include marketing processes, strategic planning and budgeting; strong written, verbal and presentation communication skills and ability to convey complex messages to influence colleagues; and ability to synthesize market and customer feedback to drive valuable innovations.
* You’re a **highly motivated professional with a passion for medical device solutions** and possess the ability to network and influence in a global matrix organization. You also have the ability to travel >10% of the time both, domestically and globally.
* **Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills** , enabling you to lead cross‑disciplinary discussions with confidence

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. This role is part of our **office‑based team** , requiring in‑person collaboration **at least three days per week** in office.

**About Philips**  
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history .
* Learn more about our purpose .

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here .

Roles & Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – POS to own the strategy, roadmap, customer

experience, and business outcomes for Ginesys’s POS portfolio across Cloud POS, Offline

POS, Mobile POS, and omnichannel store journeys. You will combine deep retail and POS

expertise with strong product craft to modernise a mission-critical store platform and shape

the future of intelligent store commerce.

Key Responsibilities

1. POS Product Strategy, Market & Discovery

● Own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile,

and Omnichannel POS within Ginesys One.

● Build deep understanding of retailers, store associates, market shifts, and global

POS competition to identify whitespace and differentiated product bets.

● Prioritise roadmap investments using customer value, market opportunity,

competitive advantage, revenue potential, and ROI; distinguish scalable needs from

one-off customisation.

● Shape the modernisation and migration strategy for existing POS capabilities while

protecting continuity for enterprise retailers.

2. Modern Store & Omnichannel Experience

inventory visibility, assisted selling, and endless aisle.

title: Product Manager – Amazon Ads | AdTech | SaaS
job_description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Product Manager with a background in an Amazon Ads agency** who has hands-on experience contributing to the development and launch of a product, tool, or SaaS platform for Amazon advertising.

The ideal candidate should understand the challenges faced by Amazon advertisers, sellers, and advertising agencies and be able to translate those challenges into practical product solutions. The candidate will be responsible for improving product usability, defining features, coordinating with development teams, and ensuring that the product is market-ready, scalable, and commercially sellable.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on taking a product from concept or development to launch, adoption, and revenue generation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Product Development & Strategy**

* Lead product development initiatives for Amazon Ads-related tools, platforms, and software solutions.
* Translate business objectives and customer requirements into product roadmaps, feature specifications, and actionable development plans.
* Identify market gaps and opportunities within Amazon Advertising, campaign management, reporting, analytics, and automation.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, business teams, and stakeholders to deliver product features aligned with market needs.

**2. User Experience & Product Usability**

* Make the product intuitive, user-friendly, efficient, and easy to navigate for Amazon sellers, agencies, and advertisers.
* Identify usability gaps and recommend improvements to product workflows, dashboards, reporting, and overall user experience.
* Gather feedback from users and customers to continuously improve product functionality.
* Work closely with UI/UX designers and developers to simplify complex advertising processes.

**3. Commercialization & Market Readiness**

* Help transform a technically functional product into a market-ready and commercially viable solution.
* Define product positioning, value propositions, use cases, and differentiation from competing products.
* Work with sales and marketing teams to develop product demonstrations, sales enablement material, and go-to-market strategies.
* Identify target customer segments, pricing opportunities, and potential revenue models.
* Support customer onboarding, product adoption, retention, and expansion.

**4. Amazon Ads Domain Expertise**

* Understand Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, campaign optimization, keyword management, bidding, and advertising performance metrics.
* Understand the day-to-day challenges of Amazon Ads agencies and sellers and how technology can solve them.
* Identify opportunities for automation, performance reporting, campaign optimization, and operational efficiency.
* Stay informed about Amazon Ads ecosystem developments, competitor products, and customer expectations.
* And Amazon DSP also

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with engineering, design, QA, sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
* Create product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization plans.
* Manage product releases, feedback cycles, bug prioritization, and continuous improvements.
* Track product performance using adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue metrics.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–8 years of relevant experience in product management, product development, or product ownership.
* Prior experience working with an **Amazon Ads agency, Amazon marketplace technology provider, or e-commerce AdTech company**.
* Demonstrable experience contributing to the development, improvement, or launch of an actual software product.
* Experience making products more user-friendly, commercially viable, and attractive to target customers.
* Strong understanding of Amazon Advertising workflows, seller requirements, and agency operations.
* Ability to connect customer pain points with product features and business outcomes.
* Experience working with technical teams and translating business requirements into product specifications.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience taking a product from concept or MVP to market launch.
* Experience with Amazon Ads APIs, advertising automation tools, analytics dashboards, or campaign management platforms.
* Exposure to SaaS pricing, competitor analysis, product positioning, and go-to-market planning.
* Experience conducting customer interviews, product demos, usability testing, and feedback sessions.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Asana, or similar platforms.

Key Success Metrics

* Product usability and customer adoption.
* Successful delivery of prioritized product features.
* Reduction in customer pain points and operational inefficiencies.
* Product-market fit and customer satisfaction.
* Product conversion, retention, and revenue growth.
* Successful commercialization and market positioning of the product.

Pay: ₹67,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Product Manager
job_description:
**ABOUT THE PRODUCT MANAGER ROLE:**

WIN is looking for Technical Product Managers to join our growing team in India. You will work at the intersection of AI, operations, data, and customer experience to build scalable, high-impact products across internal and customer-facing platforms. This is not a Scrum Master or delivery coordination role. This role requires a strong product mindset - someone who can identify opportunities before the market does, translate ambiguity into structured systems, and build products that fundamentally change how people work. You will work across AI-powered workflows, inspection operations, data intelligence, and platform thinking to create products that drive real business outcomes and long-term value.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Define and drive product strategy for internal and customer-facing platforms
* Identify product opportunities across AI, automation, analytics, and workflow optimization
* Translate complex and ambiguous business problems into structured product solutions
* Collaborate with engineering, design, operations, and leadership to shape product roadmap
* Build scalable product systems and frameworks instead of one-off feature solutions
* Prioritize initiatives based on impact, adoption, and business outcomes
* Leverage data, user research, and experimentation to deeply understand user behaviour
* Drive execution with clarity and ownership without acting as a project coordinator
* Focus on long-term product value including adoption, retention, efficiency, and ecosystem growth

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* 6+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Ownership in a product-driven company
* Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, and platform architecture fundamentals
* Familiarity with AI/LLM workflows and their practical applications in products
* Experience with product analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decision making
* Understanding of SaaS product models and workflow automation ecosystems
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams and evaluate technical feasibility
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex systems
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working in cross-functional teams in an agile environment
* Ownership mindset, curiosity, and bias for action

**GOOD TO HAVE:**  

* Experience with AI copilots, conversational interfaces, or workflow engines
* Exposure to automation tools, predictive analytics, or operational products
* Experience building or scaling B2B SaaS platforms
* Strong understanding of product-led growth principles
* Design AI-first product experiences rather than simply adding AI features

  

**WHY JOIN US?**  

* High-energy team enthusiastic about disrupting a massive industry
* Highly inclusive and collaborative culture built on mutual respect
* Focus on core values, initiative, leadership, and adaptability
* Strong emphasis on personal and professional development
* Opportunity to build AI-first products that create real business leverage
* Flexibility to work remotely

  

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* Highly inclusive and collaborative culture
* Opportunity to work closely with India-based and US-based teams
* Strong focus on learning, ownership, and growth
* 100% remote working flexibility

  

**ABOUT WIN & OUR CULTURE:**

WIN is the #1 ranked inspection services company in the United States. Backed by 35 years of excellence, we are on a mission to build a global brand through cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven innovation, and operational excellence. WIN has the stability of an established leader as well as the energy of a fast-growing organization. We offer like-minded professionals a unique opportunity for meaningful personal and professional growth.

The role requires strong experience in preparing PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, product documentation, solution documents and presentations, while working closely with engineering, QA, business and customer teams. Does working with IoT devices, sensors, wearables, controllers which can seamlessly merge the digital world with the physical world around us interests you?

We are working on IoT solutions that can be used to solve massive scale problems by connecting things to people.

As a company we are digitizing the electricity distribution grids to bring down network losses and ensure that electricity reaches every household.

We do this by building sensors, controllers, low power edge devices, connect and manage multiple sensors with our ecosystem.

We have been awarded as the Startup of the Year 2018 and our wireless technology in 2020, has been awarded by India Smart Grid Forum, Government of India.

We have also been mentored by Cisco and Qualcomm in their startup accelerators.

We are a Venture Capital funded company and have raised our A1 round series in 2025.

 Are a team of technologists from diverse backgrounds

 Are comfortable in an agile environment and create order from ambiguity

 Want to create applications at a massive scale used by millions of people

 Use data to make decisions and validate assumptions

 Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, design, and delivery of products within the Private Funds domain of the Clearwater system. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from defining the product and planning development through production and go-to-market. You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.
* **Product Ownership:** Own the Private Funds product(s) end to end, from ideation through market launch and ongoing evolution.
* **Backlog Management:** Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.
* **Technical Requirement Definition:** Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.
* **Private Funds Data Modeling:** Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.
* **Data Versioning & Integrity:** Specify how data is versioned, corrected, and restated (e.g., immutable, transaction-based designs), and define approaches to entity matching, alias/deduplication, and reconciliation across sources.
* **AI & Automation:** Shape and prioritize agentic and Generative AI capabilities, such as automated document procurement, extraction, classification, and validation. Define accuracy targets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and evaluation methods.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
* **Roadmap Creation:** Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
* **Client Engagement:** Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
* **Operational Partnership:** Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.
* **Success Measurement:** Define KPIs (e.g., data accuracy, coverage, timeliness, straight-through processing rates, adoption, NPS) and use data-driven insights to guide future decisions.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Act as the go-to expert on private funds and alternative investments, supporting sales, client conversations, and product strategy.
* **Employee Engagement:** Participate in large-scale initiatives that promote employee retention and engagement.
* **Process Improvement:** Teach and guide other teams toward effective processes and best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
* Deep knowledge of Private Markets (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Assets, Fund of Funds) and the financial services landscape.
* Strong understanding of private fund structures and documents, including LPAs, capital account statements, PCAPs, capital calls and distributions, and NAV and performance reporting.
* Working technical fluency: relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, data pipelines, and ETL concepts. You can read schemas and engage credibly in design discussions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and agentic AI technologies, including document intelligence, extraction, and evaluation, and an understanding of their practical limits in financial data workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate across sales, product, operations, and technology.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and documentation abilities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong computer skills.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in product management or related roles, including experience owning a technical or data-intensive product.
* 4+ years of professional experience in Investment Management, Operations, or Accounting, with direct exposure to private funds data or workflows.
* Demonstrated experience writing business and technical requirements for a financial technology product or service.
* Experience in data visualization and analytics.
* Demonstrated client engagement experience, with a focus on understanding and addressing client needs.
* Experience presenting to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Alternative Investments, including Private Equity, Limited Partnerships, Private Credit, Mortgage and Bank Loans, or Derivatives.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with fund administration, LP reporting, or portfolio monitoring platforms.
* Experience with master data management, entity resolution, or data quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience launching AI-enabled data extraction or document processing products.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager (Tier 1 & 5+ Years experience)
job_description:
**About Us:**

**Luna is a health intelligence company**. Our wearables and LifeOS platform build a working model of your body, and turn it into a plan for your day. Luna Ring and Luna Band read continuous biomarker signals, from sleep and recovery to heart rate variability, circadian phase and menstrual cycle. LifeOS combines that with your nutrition, supplements, blood panels and daily context to build a plan for your day: what to do, and when to do it. Luna ships to 150+ countries, and our work has been recognised by the global tech press and international design and innovation awards.

We're grounded in science, driven by data, and occasionally powered by questionable coffee choices. But above all, we’re united by a shared mission: to reimagine how wearable tech can help people know themselves better and push their potential further.

**Your Role:**

We’re looking for a Product Manager – App to lead our health-tech experience and build our LifeOS.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, CX, and our beta community to deliver features that are elegant, evidence-based, and habit-forming.

**Responsibilities:**

● Own and evolve the entire Luna App roadmap, including onboarding, dashboard design,

insights, and user journeys.

● Lead product discovery and delivery for high-impact features like Energy OS, Circadian Rhythm,

Sleep Recovery and AI-based health layer.

● Have a strong understanding towards building algorithms

● Drive measurable improvements in app retention, App Store rating, feature adoption, and

session engagement.

● Translate complex physiological and behavioral science into simple, engaging app flows.

● Use data (Amplitude / Firebase / Mixpanel) to learn user behaviour

● Interact on and close the loop on feedback from beta groups and other digital communities.

**Requirements:**

*Must-Have:*

● 5+ years of product experience, with at least 2+ years leading a consumer mobile app

● Bachelors/M.S/Phd in Data Science, ML, Statistics from a Tier 1 college

● Personal interest in quantified self, training, mindfulness, sleep science, or longevity

● Experience in deep-healthtech, wellness, wearables, or fitness—with user empathy and domain

fluency.

● Exposure to AI productization, health APIs

● Strong data, algorithms understanding is critical to this role.

● Demonstrated ability to improve app retention, adoption, or ratings through thoughtful product

changes.

● Deep familiarity with mobile UX, behavioral design, and habit loop creation.

● Comfort with using data tools (Amplitude, Firebase, etc.) and setting clear success metrics.

● High clarity of thought; can operate independently, structure ambiguity, and move

cross-functional teams.

● A strong POV on what makes a truly great app experience in the wellness space.

**What You’ll Get:**

● A front-row seat to the future of wearable intelligence

● Massive ownership and impact on a fast-growing global product

● Chance to build the world’s most advanced LifeOS.

● Competitive compensation + ESOPs

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current CTC?
* What is the Notice Period in your current Company?

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager - Vice President ConnectWealth
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Lead a team of Product Managers and drive the ConnectWealth related enhancements and buildouts across regions including mandates platform enhancements

As a Product Owner, Vice President in the ConnectWealth Product team, you will design and deliver strategic solutions for a platform managing over $640 billion in AUM across 900,000 accounts. You will partner with stakeholders to develop and prioritize business requirements within an Agile framework, ensuring seamless delivery of innovative capabilities. You will also navigate regulatory complexity, drive operational readiness, and lead cross-functional collaboration to solve high-impact challenges under tight deadlines.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Gather Advisor needs via user research and journey mapping to identify high-value platform features.
* Develop business requirements in partnership with Portfolio Management, Technology, Operations, and Product Development teams.
* Document requirements in Epic/Story format within JIRA, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
* Lead story refinement and grooming sessions with Technology partners to align on scope and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the UAT team to condition acceptance criteria and provide product oversight during testing.
* Manage stakeholder updates across APAC, EMEA, and US on enhancement status, timelines, and milestones.
* Escalate risks and issues promptly through formal governance channels, addressing control and scope impacts.
* Support Advisors day-to-day by resolving platform queries and issues on a prioritized basis.
* Collaborate with Business Management, Compliance, and control functions to ensure regulatory and operational alignment.
* Drive mandates platform enhancements as part of the firm's strategic ConnectWealth initiative.
* Analyze platform usage and operational data to identify trends and inform roadmap prioritization.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Hold a Master's or Post-Graduate degree with 10+ years in financial services, including 5+ years leading 5-10 member teams in wealth management.
* Demonstrate proven product management expertise for large-scale business and technology initiatives.
* Think analytically and innovatively, fostering teamwork and collaboration across global, cross-functional teams.
* Manage stakeholders effectively across functional groups and regions with strong influencing skills.
* Communicate clearly and concisely at all organizational levels with strong verbal and written skills.
* Demonstrate accountability and adaptability in a dynamic environment requiring creative problem-solving and attention to detail.
* Build and sustain effective internal partnerships across Technology, Operations, Compliance, and Business Management.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Apply experience with scripting languages such as SAS and Python for product analytics and process optimization.
* Leverage hands-on experience with digital transformation and fintech integration in Wealth Management.
* Utilize data analytics tools and methodologies to drive evidence-based product decisions.
* Explore emerging technologies in finance to enhance platform capabilities and Advisor experiences.
* Draw on prior collaboration with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams.
* Navigate the regulatory and operational landscape of international wealth management across regions.
* Operate proficiently in Agile tools including JIRA-based backlog management and sprint planning.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Product Manager
job_description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* **Using AI.** Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* **Supporting sales and delivery.** Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* **Guiding customers off legacy.** Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

**For US candidates:** A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.

**For non-US candidates:** A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.

We offer:

* **Real impact.** Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* **Modern stack.** Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* **Direct customer contact.** You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* **Growth.** GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.

**Working Arrangement**
-----------------------

Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager with experience building B2C consumer internet products. Someone who understands users, can identify the right problems to solve, and knows how to take a product from an idea to launch.

At FOXO, you'll work closely with founders, designers, engineers, and business teams to shape the product roadmap and turn business priorities into products that people find useful and want to keep using.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and being involved in every stage of product development, from understanding user needs to launching features and improving them based on feedback and data.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own product initiatives from discovery and planning to launch and ongoing improvements.
* Work with founders and leadership to define product priorities and build the roadmap.
* Speak to users, gather feedback, and use product data to understand what needs to improve.
* Turn business requirements and user problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Design and Engineering to build and ship products that are easy to use.
* Identify ways to improve user onboarding, conversion, engagement, and retention.
* Prioritise features based on user needs, business impact, and engineering effort.
* Define product metrics and track how features perform after launch.
* Run experiments and A/B tests to understand what works and what doesn't.
* Study user journeys and drop-off points to identify areas for improvement.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to keep product development and launches on track.
* Maintain clear documentation of product requirements, decisions, and workflows.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have:**

* 5–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, with relevant experience in B2C consumer internet products.
* Experience building, launching, and improving consumer-facing digital products.
* A strong understanding of user behaviour, product discovery, and the product development lifecycle.
* Experience owning product roadmaps and taking initiatives from problem identification through execution.
* Comfort working with product analytics and customer feedback to make product decisions.
* Understanding of key product metrics such as activation, conversion, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
* Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, product flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to take products from concept to launch.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with different teams.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities can change and not every problem has an obvious answer.
* Ability to take ownership and drive projects independently.

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with consumer apps or high-growth B2C businesses.
* Experience building products from an early stage and scaling them as the user base grows.
* Exposure to AI-powered consumer products or AI/LLM-based features.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or PostHog.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, and Notion.
* Working knowledge of SQL for analysing product data.

What Success Looks Like:

* Building products that address real user needs.
* Improving user adoption, engagement, and retention through meaningful product changes.
* Using customer feedback and data to decide what to build and what to improve.
* Taking ownership of product initiatives and delivering them with the team.
* Making thoughtful product decisions, learning from results, and improving the product over time.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Notice Period
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Are you open to relocating to Bangalore?

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Tech Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, development, and scaling of next-generation healthcare data and AI-driven products. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, analytics, and operations, translating complex healthcare challenges into innovative digital solutions that improve clinical, operational, and member outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong product management expertise, technical depth, healthcare domain knowledge, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business value.

You will partner with engineering, architecture, data science, operations, and business stakeholders to define product vision, prioritize investments, and drive adoption of scalable solutions that support strategic healthcare initiatives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Vision
  + Define and execute short and long-term product strategies, roadmaps, and investment priorities for healthcare technology products and platforms
  + Partner with business leaders, customers, and technology teams to identify opportunities that improve healthcare outcomes, operational efficiency, and business performance
  + Translate strategic objectives into product capabilities, business cases, and prioritized delivery plans
  + Define product success metrics, KPIs, customer outcomes, and value realization measures
* Product Ownership & Delivery
  + Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation, discovery, and definition through launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement
  + Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans
  + Prioritize and manage product backlogs to maximize customer value and business impact
  + Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements
  + Monitor product performance and continuously refine priorities based on data, customer feedback, and market insights
* Healthcare Data & AI Enablement
  + Drive development of healthcare data products, analytics platforms, AI/ML capabilities, and intelligent automation solutions
  + Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to define data acquisition, integration, governance, analytics, and consumption strategies
  + Identify opportunities to leverage generative AI, predictive analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve workflows and decision-making
  + Define requirements for APIs, interoperability solutions, reporting platforms, and healthcare data services
  + Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and regulatory requirements are embedded within product designs
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, operations, and leadership
  + Facilitate alignment across multiple teams and portfolios to deliver integrated product solutions
  + Influence priorities and drive decisions in a complex matrixed environment without direct authority
  + Communicate product vision, roadmap, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leaders and stakeholders

  + Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and prioritization activities
  + Ensure product initiatives are decomposed into actionable features and well-defined user stories
  + Manage dependencies, delivery risks, and trade-off decisions across teams
  + Leverage Agile methodologies and product management best practices to improve delivery effectiveness and speed to market
  + Drive continuous product improvement through experimentation, measurement, and customer feedback

  + Present product strategy, roadmap, business value, and performance metrics to executive leadership
  + Collaborate with business development, operations, implementation, and client teams to identify emerging opportunities
  + Mentor product owners and product managers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration
  + Act as a trusted advisor on healthcare technology trends, AI adoption, and product best practices
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in product management or equivalent
* 8+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Development, Digital Product Management
* 5+ years of experience defining product requirements, writing user stories, and managing Agile product backlogs
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale technology products, platforms, or data-driven solutions
* Experience working with cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, data platforms, analytics, and digital technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, analytics, data science, and business teams
* Experience using product management and Agile tools such as Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product capabilities, business processes, or customer experiences
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and modern product management practices
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions
* Demonstrated solid analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex cross-functional dependencies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within healthcare, payer, provider, population health, payment integrity, claims, clinical, or healthcare analytics domains
* Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics products

* Experience leading large-scale digital transformation or enterprise modernization initiatives

job_description:
**Company Description**

**About Entain India**

There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description**

This is a hybridrole. As a Senior Product Manager - Missions you will be responsible for leading a cross-functional squad focused on solving a clearly defined, high-value customer or business problem.

Working with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to own measurable outcomes from strategy and discovery through to delivery.

Reporting to the Director of Product you will be part of the Product team, who will own a strategically important mission and its outcomes from end to end. Shape the product strategy, roadmap and priorities around a measurable customer or business problem.

You Will:

* Shape the product strategy, roadmap and priorities around a measurable customer or business problem.
* Lead discovery and delivery with engineering, design, data and commercial partners.
* Use customer insight, data and experimentation to test assumptions and adapt investment decisions.
* Define success metrics and align stakeholders around priorities, dependencies and trade-offs.

 **Qualifications**

You Have:

* More than five years' product management experience, with a track record of taking consumer products from concept to market.
* Experience leading cross-functional product squads against clearly defined customer or business outcomes.
* Experience turning broad or ambiguous problems into measurable outcomes, hypotheses and priorities.
* Strong experience using quantitative data, customer insight, experimentation and research to make evidence-based decisions

  
**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain India, we offer a package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3).

**How we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) in recruitment**

We may use approved AI tools to make recruitment simpler and more efficient, while keeping people at the heart of what we do. These tools support our teams and give them more time to focus on you.

**Fairness, transparency and trust**

Our recruiters and hiring managers oversee how we use AI and remain responsible for hiring decisions. These tools support administrative aspects of the recruitment process, giving our teams more time to focus on you We're open about its use and handle your information following our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. AI supports our decisions, it doesn't make them.

**Equal Opportunities**.

If you need any **reasonable adjustments** at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

We're an **equal opportunities employer**. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

title: Senior Product Manager (Salesforce Integration)
job_description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “**name@cvent.com**” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

**About the role:**

Cvent's acquisition strategy has brought together some of the most recognized names in event technology, each with their own Salesforce-native application used by event marketers and meeting professionals worldwide. As we integrate these businesses, we're creating a dedicated role to bring unified ownership, strategic clarity, and a cohesive customer experience across our entire Salesforce app portfolio.  
This is a high-impact, high-visibility position for a senior product leader who thrives at the intersection of CRM ecosystems, enterprise SaaS, and portfolio strategy. You'll be the single accountable owner across five Salesforce applications — setting the overarching strategy, driving day-to-day roadmap decisions, and ensuring Cvent stays ahead of Salesforce's evolving platform requirements.

In This Role, You Will::

Own a Portfolio of Salesforce Products  

* Serve as the single accountable owner across a portfolio of five Salesforce-native applications spanning our event technology brands — setting strategy, driving roadmap decisions, and ensuring a consistent customer experience.
* Lead our flagship Salesforce application as your core product, managing its end-to-end roadmap and balancing new feature investment against technical debt.
* Shepherd an acquired application from beta through General Availability, working closely with customers and go-to-market teams to define readiness criteria and launch successfully.
* Partner with PMs across acquired brands to align product direction and ensure cohesion across the portfolio.
* Where leadership decides to consolidate apps, own the migration workstream — defining requirements and partnering with Customer Success to ensure a seamless transition for customers.

Define the Salesforce Strategy  

* Determine whether and how Cvent moves toward a unified Salesforce app experience across acquired brands.
* Keep all applications ahead of mandatory Salesforce platform updates, security requirements, and AppExchange compliance changes.
* Make high-stakes prioritization calls across five products simultaneously — where to invest, what to consolidate, and how to sequence the roadmap.
* Embed AI as a default lens across product decisions; champion AI-native processes within your team.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment  

* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions across the portfolio; own escalation paths and surface risks proactively.
* Lead alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, UX, and acquired-company partners.
* Use data — analytics platforms, customer feedback, and OKRs — to guide prioritization and communicate progress to leadership.

Here's What You Need::

* 12+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with direct experience shipping Salesforce-native or deeply integrated CRM products.
* Salesforce AppExchange or managed package experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-product roadmaps — especially in post-acquisition or multi-brand environments.
* Experience owning customer migration or product consolidation workstreams.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and a track record of embedding AI into PM workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using platforms like Mixpanel or similar to drive adoption and measure impact.
* Exceptional communicator — comfortable aligning leadership team, engineering, and external partners around a shared product vision.

job_description:
**Company Description**

**Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build next-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high-impact products.

You will own the product end-to-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high-performing, differentiated products.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery & Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap & Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution & Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high-quality products
* **Adoption & Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

**How You Think**

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end-to-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

**Additional Information**

The recruitment process includes online assessment as a first step (logic) - we send it via e-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

Work Location: Strategy Chennai office — full-time, Monday to Friday

We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build next-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high-impact products.

You will own the product end-to-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high-performing, differentiated products.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery & Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap & Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution & Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high-quality products
* **Adoption & Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

**How You Think**

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end-to-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

**Additional Information**

The recruitment process includes online assessment as a first step (logic) - we send it via e-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

Work Location: Strategy Chennai office — full-time, Monday to Friday
