Job Title: Senior Product Manager

**Company:** Eminence Technology  
**Location:** Mohali, Punjab  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 Years  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Shift:** Night Shift  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Eminence Technology

Eminence Technology is an IT product and services company focused on delivering innovative, technology-driven solutions. We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior Product Manager** to join our team in Mohali and drive product strategy, development, and business growth.

Job Overview

The Senior Product Manager will be responsible for defining product vision, developing product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful products. The ideal candidate should have strong business acumen, analytical thinking, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into effective product solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and execute product strategy, vision, and roadmap in alignment with business objectives.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle, from ideation and requirement gathering to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, QA, marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure successful product delivery.
* Conduct market research, analyze customer feedback, and identify opportunities for product enhancement.
* Translate business requirements into product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize product features and manage the product backlog based on business priorities and customer needs.
* Work closely with development teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality product features.
* Monitor product performance through KPIs, analytics, and user feedback.
* Communicate product roadmaps, updates, priorities, and progress to stakeholders and senior management.
* Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimization, and improved user experience.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Product Management or a related role.
* Strong understanding of product strategy, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, backlog prioritization, and writing user stories.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar product management platforms.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to work the night shift and from the office in Mohali.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with IT products, SaaS platforms, or technology-driven solutions.
* Exposure to product analytics, market research, and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and aligning product initiatives with business goals.
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills**, with the ability to confidently present product strategies, communicate with stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Schedule

* **Working Days:** 5 days a week
* **Shift:** Night shift
* **Work Mode:** Work from office (On-site)
* **Location:** Mohali, Punjab

How to Apply

If you are passionate about product innovation, strategic planning, and delivering customer-focused solutions, we would love to hear from you!

Apply now to join **Eminence Technology** as a **Senior Product Manager** and contribute to building impactful technology solutions.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Powered by an outstanding end-to-end e-commerce and logistics network and a fanatical culture of customer centricity, Coupang has broken tradeoffs around speed, selection, and price. Today, we provide exceedingly fast shipping speeds on millions of items including fresh groceries, delivered within hours nationwide, 365 days a year. We are doing this for millions of consumers in Korea, one of the world's largest and fastest growing e-commerce markets. Korea is currently the 5th largest e-commerce market in the world.  
Finance Platform and Engineering (FPE) Product team owns the procure-to-cash, order- to-cash and sellers' settlement experience across various business verticals at Coupang.  
Our team collaborates with various Engineering, Finance, Seller Experience and Support teams to ensure that all transactions produced by the various platforms at Coupang with financial impact are accurately accounted for to ensure that our suppliers and sellers are paid precisely and on-time.  
  
**Job Description:**

  

We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced, and dynamic Senior Product Manager to own and drive the product strategy for how sellers interact with and consume their settlement data through the seller portal. This role focuses on ensuring that sellers have easy, intuitive, and transparent access to critical financial data, empowering them to understand and manage their payments effectively.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for how to evolve the seller settlement experience

* Drive end-to-end product development, from ideation and requirements gathering to release and continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, design, data, and finance teams

* Regularly engage with external customers and internal partner teams to gather

product requirements and feedback through discussions, presentations, and

preview programs

* Define and prioritize product features, user stories, and acceptance criteria,

maintaining a well-groomed backlog and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality

releases

* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and drive continuous improvement, adjusting the roadmap and strategy as

needed

* Communicate product status, progress and insights to stakeholders and

leadership, fostering a culture of transparency, collaboration, and data-driven

decision making

* Champion a customer-centric approach to product development, acting as an

advocate for user needs and fostering a culture of empathy and innovation

  

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance or

equivalent experience.

* 8+ years of product/program management, solutions architecture, or engineering experience, with a track record of delivering complex, large-scale technical

products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset and

commitment to evidence-based decision making.

* Demonstrates the ability to quickly grasp new concepts, technologies, and

industry trends, adapting to a constantly evolving business landscape and staying ahead of the curve.

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

* Proven ability to balance competing priorities, manage multiple projects

simultaneously, and deliver results under varying constraints.

* Consistently works backwards from customers' needs, ensuring that productdecisions are driven by a thorough understanding of user requirements, pain

points and jobs to be done.

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA or equivalent degree is a strong plus.

* Knowledge of accounting principles, financial systems, and industry best practices, with a strong understanding of the unique challenges faced by eCommerce businesses.

* Experience building and launching Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).

title: Senior Product Manager- Technical
job_description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Product Manager- TechnicalOverview  
MasterCard Data & Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.  
• We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise• We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behaviour beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data• We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and moreThe MasterCard Data & Services Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements leading to building and commercialisation of products and services. This individual will partner closely with other Global Product Management team members to support the development of the product strategy and ensure product priorities are well-aligned with commercial objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term technical vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution. Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard • Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value • Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products• Ensure the technical success of our products through close partnerships with Technology teams• Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and trade-offs, and building scalable products that serve an array of customer segments• Set product direction with coordination, not in isolation—taking into account how our products all work together to serve customer needs  
  
Role  

* Own, define and deliver end-to-end strategy for multiple features for the products from inception to launch
* Design and conduct user research, including customer interviews, to deepen understanding of customers’ pain points, motivations and opportunities
* Work closely with engineering teams, designers, and operational teams to prioritize development efforts as they align against product strategy

• Determine release goals for the platforms and prioritize assigned features•  
Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives  

* Oversee timely and high-quality execution of the creation of technical requirements
* Build strong working relationships with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to achieve product goals
* Translate business priorities into clear, actionable technical requirements for the engineering team
* Identify issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirement and communicate to the leadership
* Promote internal and external feature adoption
* Partner with internal teams to answer product questions and provide product support
* Provide input into product pricing and our go-to-market strategy
* Exhibit expertise within the platform feature area and coordinate with interdependent teams

  
All About You  

* Proficient agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Extensive experience in managing analytical solutions designed for payments or related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Experience designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer, an outstanding user experience and stickiness
* Requires minimal supervision/assistance
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the data monetization, self-service analytics and predictive insights space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interface with clients
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities

• Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)•
  
Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience  

* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science or related field) a plus

• Experience in the payments industry with data insights a plus• Certifications in product management and agile processes will be an added advantage  

* An advanced degree is helpful

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Risk
job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role:**

The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.

  
  

You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.

**What you will accomplish:**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What you will bring:**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. Proven ability and in-market examples of defining a strategic vision for a new and innovative portfolio of products that drove significant impact for millions of end users at a global scale
* Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle from planning through deployment; experience leveraging test and validation frameworks throughout the product lifecycle. Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in Agile teams is desirable
* Must have a passion for our sellers and the relentless drive to improve experiences for our sellers, influencing a higher bar on quality and ensuring the seller is always at the center of our product roadmap and priorities. Experience working with design research and qualitative tools to ensure the voice of our seller is at the center of our product development
* Strong, concise communicator and effective story-teller; experience using both analytics and qualitative research to express the vision and strategy of the product
* Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering or Business management.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role:**

The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.

  
  

You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.

**What you will accomplish:**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What you will bring:**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. Proven ability and in-market examples of defining a strategic vision for a new and innovative portfolio of products that drove significant impact for millions of end users at a global scale
* Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle from planning through deployment; experience leveraging test and validation frameworks throughout the product lifecycle. Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in Agile teams is desirable
* Must have a passion for our sellers and the relentless drive to improve experiences for our sellers, influencing a higher bar on quality and ensuring the seller is always at the center of our product roadmap and priorities. job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI** 
 
**The Opportunity**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Are you an experienced Product Manager with strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, and a passion for turning data into action? If so, join our team and help shape how Nutanix measures product adoption, customer value realization, and business outcomes across our portfolio.

In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Product Adoption & Insights. You will partner closely with Product Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to build trusted adoption metrics, actionable insights, and AI-powered recommendations that help improve customer adoption, retention, and growth.

### **Your Role:**

* Define and drive strategy and roadmap for Product Adoption & Insights initiatives across the Nutanix portfolio.
* Partner with Product Managers, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to gather requirements and identify opportunities to improve adoption, customer health, and value realization.
* Define and evolve adoption frameworks, telemetry requirements, customer health metrics, and executive reporting.
* Build AI-powered actionable insights that help Customer Success and Account teams proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify new opportunities and drive prioritization.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and enablement across Product, Customer Success, Field, and Corporate Strategy organizations.

### **What You Will Bring:**

* B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field is required. MBA preferred.
* 7+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years in Product Management. Experience in Product Adoption, Product Analytics, telemetry, insights, or related data-driven products is highly desirable.
* Strong experience in strategy, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and product execution.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with telemetry, product usage analytics, AI-powered recommendations, customer health metrics, or business intelligence solutions is preferred.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.

### **About the Team**

This role reports to the Director of Product Management, responsible for Product Adoption & Insights, NIVA (Nutanix Intelligent Virtual Agent), Customer Success, and Professional Services Strategy.

The team focuses on helping customers realize value faster through trusted adoption insights, AI-powered recommendations, customer success innovations, and strategic services offerings.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model.

job_description:
**[ WHO WE ARE]**

Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.

KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.

The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties that include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.

With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years and has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as Product Manager, define and manage the **roadmap** for India-facing features, collaboration events, and engagement loops.
* Write clear **PRDs**, set success metrics, and make data-driven product decisions.
* Act as **feature producer**: plan sprints, track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery.
* Lead **live-ops execution**, including events, content updates, reward systems, and real-time issue handling.
* Drive **user growth, onboarding, retention**, and monetization improvements for the Indian market.
* Collaborate with central teams, external partners, and marketing on feature launches and IP tie-ups.
* Analyze player data and market trends to optimize features and event performance.

**Qualification**

* 7–10 years in mobile gaming product management or production.
* Strong understanding of F2P systems, live-ops, and mobile game KPIs.
* Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, QA, and data.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.
* What you get in return
* Learn Best-in-class global product practices, and scope for fast growth
* Ability to learn from teams across the globe
* Open and transparent work culture with ownership
* Work on India’s biggest game of the decade.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Understands Analytics, Product Development, Producer Scrums very well, (AI part will be taught on the job)

* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.

* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

title: Senior Product Manager, Associate Satisfaction
job_description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every day, Amazon Customer Service associates help millions of customers around the world. Their ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences depends on feeling supported, empowered, and equipped to succeed.  
  
We are building new ways to understand and improve the associate experience. By listening to associates and combining their feedback with insights from their day-to-day work, we aim to identify what drives satisfaction, recognize emerging challenges, and help leaders take meaningful action.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development of products that help Amazon understand how associates experience their work. You will shape our associate listening strategy, define how we measure satisfaction across key moments in the associate journey, and partner with science and engineering teams to translate feedback into actionable insights.  
This is an opportunity to build new capabilities from the ground up and influence how Amazon improves the experience of its global Customer Service workforce.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for associate listening, satisfaction measurement, and insights capabilities.
* Develop the associate listening strategy, including survey design, question development, feedback collection, and measurement experiences.
* Partner with research and science teams to establish reliable measures of associate satisfaction, engagement, and wellbeing.
* Identify key moments in the associate journey and define how feedback and experience are measured across them.
* Combine associate feedback with operational and contextual data to identify drivers of satisfaction and emerging challenges.
* Partner with engineering and science teams to build scalable products that translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Define product success metrics and evaluate the impact of new capabilities on associate experience and business outcomes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience with survey research, employee listening platforms, Voice of Customer, or experience measurement products.
* Familiarity with survey design, sampling, response bias, and measurement validity.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job_description:
Kontakt

Your Rohde & Schwarz recruiting team is looking forward to receiving your application.

mehr

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner / Technical Product Manager to lead the roadmap, backlog, and delivery of a complex digital platform. The role requires a unique blend of business acumen and technical expertise, with responsibility for translating business needs into clear requirements, driving platform strategy, and partnering closely with developers, architects, and global stakeholders.

The successful candidate will oversee integrations across CMS, eCommerce, product content and digital asset platforms, manage cross-functional dependencies, ensure platform stability and successful releases, and champion automation, modernization, and agile best practices while coaching engineering teams toward scalable, high-quality solutions.

### **Tasks**

* Ownership of backlog and roadmap — balancing new business features, operational needs, and technical debt into transparent priorities
* Translation of business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes
* Act as a strong technical sparring partner for developers, architects, and global tech leads, including deep-dive discussions on solution design, APIs, integrations and implementation approach.
* Overview of integrations and data flows across CMS, eCommerce, product content, asset delivery
* Dependency management across international teams
* Coach and guide developers on technical topics, engineering best practices, platform understanding, and solution thinking.
* Platform health — incident prioritization, root cause follow-up, corrective actions in the backlog
* Release coordination with development and operations
* Scrum ceremonies, automation and modernization opportunities

**Exciting insights into Rohde & Schwarz**
------------------------------------------

Our colleagues provide insider information about:

* Daily adventures and challenges
* Our passionate team
* The technologies behind the innovative projects and solutions

### **Qualifications**

* Degree in Business Information Systems, IT, Computer Science, or comparable background
* 5+ years in product ownership, digital product management or platform management
* 3+ years working directly with software development teams
* Backlog ownership for an integration-heavy product — interfaces, dependencies, operational topics
* Able to read a system landscape, follow data flows and API contracts, challenge technical trade-offs, translate in both directions
* Application operations and production support — incident prioritization, root cause follow-up
* Jira, Confluence, agile delivery (Scrum, Kanban, or Scrumban)
* Excellent English

  **Nice to Have**

  + PIM, DAM, CMS, product content or asset delivery — SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP PCM, FirstSpirit or comparable
  + REST APIs, event-driven architectures, integration patterns
  + AWS or Azure, cloud-native integration services
  + Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Grafana or CloudWatch, ServiceNow
  + Background in software development, solution engineering, or technical consulting

### **Contact and further information**

We welcome your application! Submissions are preferred online via the application portal. For questions, our chatbot Paul and the recruiting team are available at any time.

Rohde & Schwarz promotes equal opportunities and welcomes applications from people with and without disabilities. We offer an inclusive work environment where all individuals can develop their skills and talents regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, worldview, age, sexual orientation, identity, and other characteristics.

At Rohde & Schwarz, we develop and produce solutions in the fields of Test & Measurement, Technology Systems, and Networks & Cybersecurity – driven by the vision of a safer and connected world. From software to final production, our more than 15,000 employees create products and systems that set global standards and enable technological sovereignty for industrial, regulatory, and government customers worldwide. Our headquarters, located in the heart of Munich, also serves as our main development site. In India the company is present as Rohde & Schwarz India Pvt. Ltd (RSINDIA) which is 100% owned subsidiary of Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG, Germany, whose head office is located in New Delhi and branch offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Field presence at Ahmedabad, Chennai and Pune. With more than 10 channel partners situated at key industrial locations we serve across the country. Our emphasis is to provide outstanding sales, service and support to our customers. The company has invested sustainably to increase the local support capability as well as to provide a fully automated Calibration facility for most of the products sold. Rohde & Schwarz India has ISO 9001:2015 certified Quality Management Systems and ISO 17025 NABL Accreditation. The company continuously invests in training its service and sales personnel regularly to maintain a high level of technical competence in pre- and post-sales support and outstanding quality in services viz. Repairs, Calibration, Product support & Project management. Rohde & Schwarz India is a financially stable company rated by CRSIL as SME 1 for more than 5 years now. This rating is the highest in its category. Rohde & Schwarz India is committed to 100% customer satisfaction through innovative product offerings and outstanding support and services. Our comprehensive and continuously growing range of services are designed to provide customers with the highest level of quality and value throughout the life cycle of our products.

### **Our Offer**

* Allowance for home office equipment
* Flexible working hour models
* Possibility of car leasing
* Sports promotion
* Health care
* (Group) accident insurance
* Online medical counselling
* Life insurance
* Corporate/team events
* Gifts for special life events

author: Hiring Manager
title: Corporate Subscriptions Product Owner
job_description:
Product · Bengaluru

You make *The Ken’s* corporate subscription a product that companies want, that their employees use, and that gets better every quarter.

Bengaluru; full-time; 2 to 4 years of experience.

  

Link Copied

  

### **About the role**

Companies already buy *The Ken* for their people. Corporate subscriptions are a significant percentage of our subscription revenue and one of the fastest-growing parts of it.

We want a corporate product that companies large and small find compelling enough to buy on their own, through the self-serve path we’ve had since 2018, without needing to be sold to. Something a 24-year-old analyst, a 34-year-old manager, and a 48-year-old business head can each use, even if what they take from it differs. Something that bundles in what we already do well beyond the daily story, such as workshops, talks, and live events, so they become part of an annual relationship rather than one-off revenue. Something that is visibly used, so that renewal is the default.

This role owns that product.

### **What you will do**

**Own the corporate product.** Define what a corporate subscription includes, for whom, at what tiers, and why. Write it down, ship it, keep changing it as you learn.

**Design for three kinds of employee.** Work out what early-career, mid-level, and senior people each need from *The Ken* and build the experiences that serve them: onboarding paths, briefings, formats, cohorts. One login for everyone is the starting point, not the product.

**Package what we already make.** Turn workshops, talks, live events, podcasts, and newsletters into things a corporate customer gets as part of the subscription. Decide what’s included, what’s an add-on, and what we stop.

**Own onboarding, activation, and engagement.** The product is only as good as the share of seats that get used. Build the onboarding flow, the activation nudges, and the account-level engagement view, and make seat usage a number everyone can see.

**Make the self-serve path work for companies.** A company should be able to discover, evaluate, buy, and expand without a call, and the buyer’s experience (admin, billing, seat management, reporting) should be as good as the reader’s.

**Define the measurement, then decide by it.** We don’t have account-level or seat-level measurement today. Define what it should count (seats active, engagement by segment, renewal, and expansion) and get it built. Know which packages activate, which features drive renewal, and where companies drop off. Kill what isn’t working.

**Talk to customers constantly.** HR and L&D buyers, the business heads who sponsor a subscription, the employees who use it or don’t. Bring what you hear into the product every month.

**Feed the people who sell.** Give them a product that’s easy to explain, obviously different, and backed by usage data that makes the renewal conversation short.

**Hold the line with the newsroom.** Many corporate customers are companies we’ve reported on critically, and they still buy. That’s the point. Exclusive features for corporates mean access, format, convenience, and curation. We never soften coverage. You keep that clear.

### **What we are looking for**

2 to 4 years in product management, growth, or a product-adjacent role at a subscription or B2B software business, ideally one where companies could buy without a salesperson. We care more about what you’ve owned and what happened to its numbers than where you worked.

You will do well here if:

– You’ve owned something end to end and can show what its numbers did while you had it.
  
– You’ve talked to enough customers to have been surprised by them.
  
– You like working out what different people need from the same product, and you’re happy building for a 24-year-old and a 48-year-old at once.
  
– You can build and read a funnel, a cohort view, and a renewal forecast, and present them to the founders monthly.
  
– You’ve killed something you built because the data said so.
  
– You can work across software, content, events, and people in the same week: an onboarding email, a workshop, a per-seat pricing argument.
  
– You read *The Ken* or something like it, and you’d rather sell a hard product honestly than an easy one loosely.
  
– Bonus: experience with L&D buyers, with packaging events or workshops into a subscription, or with seat-based pricing and activation metrics.

### **What you get**

A product of your own, with revenue attached, in a company small enough that your decisions ship. A customer base that already buys and renews, and that nobody has yet built a real product for. Resources in place: self-serve rails, a product and design team, events and workshops to bundle. And, over a year, the experience most product people at 2 to 4 years never get: owning a line from packaging to renewal, with the numbers to prove it.

Have questions?
  
Mail us at careers@the-ken.com with the name of the position in the subject line.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Engineering Product Manager
job_description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.

**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Leads complex product management work, programs, projects, or initiatives across a broad area of responsibility in alignment with product, departmental, functional, and business objectives.  
2. Translates business plans, client needs, product priorities, and functional objectives into actionable recommendations, work plans, and execution approaches.  
3. Provides subject matter expertise on complex products, processes, services, or product life-cycle activities, advising stakeholders on risks, opportunities, dependencies, and potential solutions.  
4. Partners with senior functional leaders, business line stakeholders, Legal, regulatory contacts, and cross-functional partners to interpret business challenges, align priorities, and support strategic and operational decision-making.  
5. Identifies and resolves complex product, process, operational, or client-related issues by analyzing information from multiple sources, applying sound judgment, and leveraging appropriate resources within and outside the function.  
6. Recommends and implements best practices, product enhancements, service improvements, and process changes that strengthen efficiency, quality, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.  
7. Leads or contributes to high-impact initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, influence, change management, and execution discipline across the product life cycle.  
8. Uses data, metrics, reporting, market or client insights, and performance information to guide decisions, evaluate outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.  
9. Develops and maintains strong strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff, functional partners, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and sustained performance.  
10. Serves as a technical or functional resource for colleagues by sharing expertise, providing guidance on complex matters, and supporting consistent execution of product-related work.  
11. Performs all duties according to established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline or field, with the ability to apply that expertise to complex product management work.
* Strong business acumen and ability to interpret internal and external business challenges to recommend best practices, product enhancements, or process improvements.
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate collaboration or escalation.
* Ability to influence outcomes, negotiate change, and guide stakeholders across areas of responsibility without direct people management authority.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise senior functional management and build strategic relationships across the function.
* Experience leading complex initiatives, coordinating cross-functional work, and maintaining execution discipline across multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Knowledge of product management activities, operational processes, controls, risk considerations, and product life-cycle requirements within the area of responsibility.
* Ability to use data, metrics, reporting, and performance information to guide recommendations, measure outcomes, and improve product or process effectiveness.

**EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s/University degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including experience managing complex products, processes, programs, or initiatives; advising stakeholders on product-related matters; and influencing cross-functional outcomes in alignment with business objectives.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 2 years as Senior Consultant/Associate Specialist/Section Manager/Operations Manager to move as a Specialist
* 1 year as Division Manager to move as a Specialist

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

**Overview**

Security is one of the most critical challenges facing organisations today. Threats are becoming more sophisticated, enterprise environments are increasingly diverse, and AI is rapidly changing both how attacks are carried out and how security products are built and operated.

Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.

We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.

This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.

* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.

* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.

* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.

* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.

* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.

* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.

* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.

* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.

* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.

* Experience working with large enterprise customers and security operations or IT administration personas.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Endpoint Security: Deep understanding of endpoint protection, threat detection, and endpoint detection and response across modern enterprise environments.

* Device & Mobile Security: Experience with Microsoft Intune or equivalent device management and security solutions, including mobile device/application management, device compliance, and Android/iOS security.

* Enterprise & Cross-Platform Security: Experience securing diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with a strong understanding of the needs of large enterprise customers, security operations teams, and IT administrators.

  
  
  

Applied Sciences IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 - $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:  
https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Join the Intuit Platform and Development Xcceleration group as a Senior Staff Product Manager. The PDX group builds the foundational capabilities that developers across Intuit rely on to build and run flagship applications on cloud native infrastructure at scale. Intuit believes in open source, both as a consumer and a contributor, and our engineers participate actively in communities including CNCF, Istio, and Argo.

We're looking for a product leader who can own two connected platform domains: the systems that provision and run Intuit's cloud infrastructure, and the systems that make Intuit's APIs and services usable by AI agents, not just human developers. You'll set direction for how infrastructure gets provisioned against policy, and for how AI agents discover, integrate with, and operate Intuit's internal services with less and less human intervention over time.

This role carries senior staff scope. You'll set product strategy independently, make tradeoffs other teams will build against, and represent these platforms directly to engineering and executive stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's infrastructure orchestration and provisioning platform, working closely with the engineering teams who build and operate it.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's agent-readiness platform, which evaluates how usable Intuit's internal APIs and services are for AI agents and drives the work that closes the gaps.
* Define the metrics that matter for each platform, from infrastructure reliability and provisioning speed to how much manual work it still takes before an agent can operate a given capability end to end, and use those metrics to prioritize the roadmap.
* Partner with the teams that define platform policy, identity, access, lifecycle rules, so that what you build upholds that policy rather than duplicating or drifting from it.
* Work with capability teams across Intuit to help them raise their agent-readiness scores, generate the integration assets they're missing, and turn what used to be manual, tribal-knowledge work into something an agent or a new engineer can follow directly.
* Represent both platforms to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, with a clear narrative tying platform investment to developer productivity and to Intuit's broader AI strategy.
* Build and run a scrum team based in India, setting the cadence, backlog discipline, and quality bar that let a distributed team ship independently.

**Qualifications**

* 10 or more years of product management experience, including platform, infrastructure, or developer-tools products.
* Direct experience with AI-enabled products or platforms, with a strong enough technical foundation to work through integration and architecture tradeoffs with engineering.
* Strong experience with AI Evals, model evaluations, technical use cases, shared platform capabilities, driving adoption and growth of platform capabilities, and leveraging AI to assess technical capabilities, and agentic PDLC.
* A track record of owning a product end to end: setting strategy, defining success metrics, and driving a roadmap that a distributed engineering team executes against.
* Comfort partnering across adjacent platform teams where ownership boundaries matter, and judgment about when to defer to another team's policy versus when to push back.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives.
* Experience managing or closely partnering with engineering teams based in India strongly preferred.
* Undergraduate degree in computer science or a related technical discipline required. Equivalent professional experience will be considered. Advanced degree or MBA preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

job_description:
**It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!**

Job Description:

**Sr. Product Manager – Master Data Management**

Ingram Micro is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Manager to drive the roadmap and execution of key master data initiatives that shape the foundation of how our business operates. This is an important role in Ingram Micro's company-wide master data transformation journey — helping build the data structures, governance frameworks, and product experiences that power trusted, consistent, and scalable data across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.

**You Will:**

* Drive the product roadmap and execution for one or more master data domains by deeply understanding business needs, data quality challenges, and the evolving enterprise data landscape.
* Advance a unified approach to master data — including product, customer, vendor, and financial data domains — ensuring consistency, accuracy, and accessibility across the organization.
* Design and improve data governance processes, data stewardship workflows, and master data lifecycle management experiences that empower business users and reduce friction.
* Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Analytics, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations teams to define, develop, and launch master data solutions and capabilities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement to eliminate data quality issues, reduce manual data handling, and deliver measurable business outcomes such as time savings, cost reduction, and improved decision-making.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to understand how master data flows across systems, identify gaps, and lead initiatives that improve data reliability and trustworthiness across the enterprise.
* Monitor and analyze the health and adoption of master data products, using insights to inform the ongoing transformation roadmap.

**You Have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross-functional go-to-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of analytics tools such as Looker or Adobe Analytics, as well as data pipeline or integration concepts, preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.
